steps.content: You've temporarily eliminated the enemies around the shields, but the uneasy atmosphere remains.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Why did you bring Chief here? He's just faced the Black Ring and been in the cell for so long. His body hasn't recovered yet. Why did you have to take him to such a dangerous place?!
steps.female_content: Why did you bring Chief here? She's just faced the Black Ring and been in the cell for so long. Her body hasn't recovered yet. Why did you have to take her to such a dangerous place?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: When Chief goes back, aren't they going to...

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Don't worry, the 9th Agency doesn't need permission from them. We agents are always the ones to give others trouble, it's never the other way round.
Hecate is still wary against Langley, shielding you with her own body, a rare and intense hostility oozing out of her. Langley smiles and glances at you.
You put a hand on Hecate's shoulder.
You make an OK sign with your hand, then smile and pat her on the head.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm relieved to see that you guys are doing fine.

steps.content: Your gaze falls onto Hella too. You haven't seen her in a while. She seems fine, just a little quiet. She quickly glances away when she feels your gaze, as if troubled by something.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: You have a team of adorable subordinates, very loyal.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't understand what you mean.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: It's just a reminder. I'm quite fond of you, as someone who shares similar experiences, I'd like to offer you some advice.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Don't hold onto your little secrets and lock yourself up.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: You can't shoulder everything yourself, especially when it comes to things like this...
Just when she finishes, as if sensing your conversation, the red luminous ring begins wiggling.
You hear a soft chuckle. A slender black figure comes out from the Black Ring.
I feel it... Special audiences... Different audiences...
Are you... here to watch me dance?
